summary: A clean off-white (#fdfdfd) portfolio hero. Two small black serif paragraphs sit top-left ("I design products and the / stories behind them. [more]", left edge x=124, y≈106) and top-right ("Currently studying Arts, / Technology, & Business @ USC", right-aligned to x≈1438). Across the bottom runs a giant black serif "Sam Cheng" (cap height ≈225px, y≈770–1060), bleeding off both side edges and the bottom ("g" cut at the right edge). In the middle hangs a 3D physics lanyard: a dark charcoal flat strap forms a V from the top edge (x≈651 and x≈912) down to a silver metal swivel clip at x≈780, y≈290–400, holding a clear plastic badge holder (≈327×525px, rounded corners, two punched holes and a slot at the top, a ridged zip seal line under them). The holder is transparent plastic: its clear margin shows the giant black text through it, while the white card inside is opaque and hides the "C" of the giant name. The card carries "Sam" in black and "Cheng" in blue (#1a1ae6-ish) serif with a slightly rough, inky printed edge, then "Currently / Design, Tech, & Business @ USC / Previously" and three pills: black "Kleiner Perkins Fellows", red "Oracle", purple "Multiply". A soft grey drop shadow falls right and down behind the badge and the strap. Only the lanyard and badge move: at 0.5–1.0s the badge sways a few degrees; from ≈1.35s the cursor (a grab hand) drags it up and right, the strap bends and the badge lies rotated ≈90° at the top right (2.5s); it is released and swings pendulum-like, is grabbed and flung again around 5.5–6.5s and 9.5–11s, and from ≈12s swings with decaying amplitude, settling to a slight tilt by 17.5s. The corner text and the giant name never move.

criteria.check: The background is a flat off-white (≈#fdfdfd) with no gradient or texture
Top-left reads exactly 'I design products and the' on line 1 and 'stories behind them. [more]' on line 2
The intro text's left edge is at x≈124 and its first line's top at y≈106
'[more]' is grey and underlined while the rest of the paragraph is black
Top-right reads exactly 'Currently studying Arts,' then 'Technology, & Business @ USC'
The status text is right-aligned with its right edge at x≈1438
Both corner paragraphs are set in a black serif at ≈17px, regular weight
A giant 'Sam Cheng' spans the bottom of the frame
The giant name is a black (#060606) regular-weight serif with bracketed serifs
The giant 'S' starts at x≈0 and the cap tops sit at y≈775; the 'g' is cut by the right edge and its descender reaches y≈1060
The giant letters' cap height is about 225px (top ≈775, baseline ≈1000)
A dark charcoal flat strap runs from the top edge in a V to a single point above the badge
At rest the strap leaves the top edge at x≈651–675 and x≈890–912 and meets at x≈780, y≈280
The strap is a flat ≈14px band of charcoal (#2e312d), not a thin line and not pure black
The clip is a silver/grey metal loop and hook with light-to-dark shading, hooked through the holder's top slot
At rest the holder spans about x 617–944 and y 360–885, centred near x≈780
The holder has rounded corners (≈18px radius) and a thin light grey outline
The top strip of the holder has exactly two round holes (one at each side) and one rounded horizontal slot between them
A ridged seal line of fine horizontal grey lines crosses the holder below the holes at y≈425–435
The holder is clear plastic: the giant black letter stem shows through its right margin at x≈925–940, y≈770–870
The holder is NOT frosted or blurred: text seen through its margin stays sharp-edged, and it is NOT a solid white panel
The card inside is opaque light grey/white and fully hides the giant 'C' behind it
The card shows 'Sam' in black serif ≈70px with 'Cheng' directly below it, overlapping its bottom
'Cheng' on the card is bright saturated blue (≈#1a1ae6), 'Sam' is black
The card name letters have a rough, inky printed edge (slightly fuzzy), not a perfectly crisp vector edge
Lower on the card: 'Currently' in bold italic, then 'Design, Tech, & Business @ USC' in grey, then 'Previously' in bold italic
Exactly three pills sit in one row at the card's bottom-left
The pills read, left to right, 'Kleiner Perkins Fellows', 'Oracle', 'Multiply'
Pill fills are black, red and deep purple respectively, each with white serif text and fully rounded ends
A soft blurred light-grey shadow lies to the right of and below the badge, with no hard edge
The strap also casts a soft grey shadow offset to the right of it on the background
The giant name does not move at all between the two moments
Neither corner paragraph moves between the two moments
Between 0.25s and 0.63s the badge sways: it tilts a few degrees and its bottom shifts ≈30px left while the strap top stays fixed
By 2.5s the badge has been dragged up and right: it lies rotated ≈90° (text reading bottom-to-top) near x 830–1355, y 195–515
During the drag the strap bends into a curve and follows the badge instead of staying a rigid V
Once the badge moves away the full giant 'C' becomes visible (it is no longer covered)
At 7.93s the badge hangs tilted ≈35° counter-clockwise with its body lower-right of the clip, the strap bowed to the left
The badge is grabbed and lifted to the top of the frame again around 5.5–6.5s and 9.5–11s (badge near the top, rotated sideways)
From ≈12s to 17.5s the badge swings like a pendulum with shrinking amplitude: ≈15° tilt at 16.9s, ≈10° at 17.52s, returning toward hanging centred under x≈780
The shadow moves and rotates with the badge rather than staying in place
While over or dragging the badge the cursor is an open/grab hand, elsewhere an arrow
The holder, clip and strap are drawn as a rendered 3D object (shaded plastic and metal), not a flat outline icon
